nomen.name: SubD Race Probe
nomen.info: Stress test for the surface-mesh cache race in ON_SubD. RH-96821.

inputs.name: Cells
inputs.info: Grid cells per side of the SubD (16 is a good default; bigger = wider race window).

inputs.name: Threads
inputs.info: Number of parallel Mesh.CreateFromSubD calls to race on the shared SubD.

inputs.name: Clear per iteration
inputs.info: If true, ClearEvaluationCache() is called at the top of every thread's iteration so the cache-empty race window is re-opened on every call.

outputs.name: Divergent count
outputs.info: Number of parallel calls whose resulting mesh's (vertex-count, face-count, vertex-position-hash) differed from a single-threaded baseline. Non-zero = race caught.

outputs.name: Invalid count
outputs.info: Number of parallel calls that returned a null mesh, an IsValid==false mesh, or a mesh with zero vertices / faces.

outputs.name: Exception count
outputs.info: Number of parallel calls that threw an exception.

nomen.name: Test Display Settings
nomen.info: Try out all possible parameters of the new mesh shader

inputs.name: Mesh
inputs.info: The mesh to draw

inputs.name: Emission colour
inputs.info: The emission colour (standard meta Display.Emission).

inputs.name: Diffuse colour
inputs.info: The diffuse colour (standard meta Display.Diffuse, applied by the guise system).

inputs.name: Colour skewness
inputs.info: The colour skewness for zany configuration (standard meta Display.Vigour).

inputs.name: Desaturation
inputs.info: The amount of desaturation in dark areas (custom meta Desaturation, 0-1).

inputs.name: Striping
inputs.info: A toggle to turn striping on and off (custom meta Striping; gates StripeWidth/StripeContrast).

inputs.name: Stripe width
inputs.info: The stripe width (custom meta StripeWidth; only applied when Striping is true).

inputs.name: Stripe contrast
inputs.info: The stripe contrast (custom meta StripeContrast; only applied when Striping is true).

inputs.name: Stippling
inputs.info: A toggle to turn stippling/dithering on and off (custom meta Stippling; gates StipplingAmount).

inputs.name: Stippling amount
inputs.info: The stippling amount in percent (custom meta StipplingAmount, 0-99). Only applied when Stippling is true.

inputs.name: Brightness
inputs.info: This parameter does not alter any colour gradient; it only reparameterises the emission→diffuse transition (standard meta Display.Glow).

inputs.name: Lmax
inputs.info: Spherical harmonics maximum degree (0-5). Higher values capture more lighting detail (custom meta Lmax).

inputs.name: Option
inputs.info: Shader option (0-20, custom meta Option). Default in DisplaySettings is 19 = SH + Lambertian gate.

inputs.name: Blend mode
inputs.info: Blend mode for option 15+ (0=LumaChroma, 1=Oklab, 2=PrincipalAxis). Custom meta BlendMode.

inputs.name: Shade false colour
inputs.info: Whether to shade meshes that carry per-vertex false colours (custom meta ShadeFalseColour).

inputs.name: Wireframe
inputs.info: Render as wireframe (custom meta Wireframe).

inputs.name: Welded thickness
inputs.info: Wireframe thickness for welded edges, in pixels (custom meta WeldedThickness).

inputs.name: Unwelded thickness
inputs.info: Wireframe thickness for unwelded edges, in pixels (custom meta UnweldedThickness).

inputs.name: Naked thickness
inputs.info: Wireframe thickness for naked (true boundary) edges, in pixels (custom meta NakedThickness).

inputs.name: Non-manifold thickness
inputs.info: Wireframe thickness for non-manifold edges (three or more faces), in pixels (custom meta NonManifoldThickness).

inputs.name: Welded thickness

inputs.name: Unwelded thickness

inputs.name: Naked thickness
inputs.info: Naked-edge (true boundary) thickness in pixels. Zero skips naked edges.

inputs.name: Non-manifold thickness
inputs.info: Non-manifold-edge (three or more faces) thickness in pixels. Zero skips them.

outputs.name: Data
